name: Fungal Connections
source:
Oliwia wants to leave her home and become a full-fledged merchant. She encounters a mysterious being in the woods that may change her life in an expanding way!

Will it change her life forever? 

[Edited from [url=https://peppekzmagimerlin.itch.io/fungal-connections]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
奥莉维娅渴望离开家乡，成为一名独当一面的商人。然而在森林之中，她邂逅了一个神秘的存在——这场相遇或许会以一种令她身体“膨胀”的方式改变她的人生！

这会彻底改写她的一生吗？

[整理自[url=https://peppekzmagimerlin.itch.io/fungal-connections]Itch.io[/url]]
